messages.subject: Too much time running the doc (Shiny)
messages.subject_clean: Too much time running the doc (Shiny)
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I'm just wondering if there's a pattern for big documents with several static plots and a small dynamic part (shiny).

The problem is that i'm expending a lot of time running this document.

Solution 1) Separate the static part and put a link to the dynamic part. Don't know if it's possible to call the dynamic part with parameters or if it's possible to share my dataframes in this call.

Solution 2) Generate plots before ant put everything inside one document with shiny runtime. I tried to use cache=True but it keeps generating everything.

What would be the best approach?

Is there any link with information about this subject?

Could you suggest any sample project on GitHub?

Thanks.

messages.subject: Using custom knit_print functions in r notebooks
messages.subject_clean: Using custom knit_print functions in r notebooks
messages.body_plain:
Hi, I'm trying to create a custom knit_print function and unfortunately this does not work as expected. I read through the [vignette](https://cran.rstudio.com/web/packages/knitr/vignettes/knit_print.html) and tried a simple example: library(knitr) knit_print.foo = function(input,...){ asis_output(input) } test <- "
elder's dependency
value N raw % valid % cumulative %
independent 66 7.27 7.33 7.33
slightly dependent 225 24.78 24.97 32.30
moderately dependent 306 33.70 33.96 66.26
severely dependent 304 33.48 33.74 100.00
missings 7 0.77
total N=908 · valid N=901 · x̄=2.94 · σ=0.94
" class(test) = "foo" test This howeverdoes not return the html version of the object in an rnotebook. If I wrap asis_output() around the object manually, there is no problem and the table is printed. Can you please help me out here? I posted a related on stackoverflow [here](http://stackoverflow.com/questions/41172411/add-native-knitr-print-methods).

messages.subject: How to show a string vector as bullet list
messages.subject_clean: How to show a string vector as bullet list
messages.body_plain:
HI all,

I'd like to show a string vector as bullet list in rmarkdown. How can I do that? I have web searching for a while and found nothing.

For example, I have

##
```{r}
  string.list <- c('first item', 'second item', 'third item')
```

Is there any function that I can apply to string.list, to generate

- first item
- second item
- third item

in the compiled markdown file?

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] How to show a string vector as bullet list
messages.subject_clean: [knitr] How to show a string vector as bullet list
messages.body_plain:
```{r results='asis'}

string.list <- c('first item', 'second item', 'third item')

cat(paste('-', string.list), sep = '\n')
```

Regards,
Yihui
--
https://yihui.name
